newsitem.title: CHINA: China's Guangdong Overseas Trust acquires firm.
newsitem.headline: China's Guangdong Overseas Trust acquires firm.

text.p: Guangdong Overseas Chinese Trust and Investment Corp said on Monday it has taken over another domestic finance firm, the Guangdong South Finance Service Company.
"The merger...is due to policy reasons," the official told Reuters by telephone from the southern city of Guangzhou.

The People's Bank of China, the central bank, had revoked the financial business licence of the Guangdong South Finance Service Company and approved a merger of the company into Guangdong Overseas, said the official.

Total assets of the Guangdong South Finance Service Company reached 1.31 billion yuan ($157 million) as of the end of last year, the China Securities newspaper quoted a company annual report as saying.
The Guangdong Overseas official declined to give details of the acquired company's net assets.
Two securities subsidiaries of Guangdong South Finance Service Company would not be included in the acquisition, the newspaper said though it gave no further details.
